subject: vec/api: fix insert for index == len
summary: `BitVec::insert` bounded the index with `0 .. self.len()`, so calling `bv.insert(bv.len(), v)` — the push-equivalent case — panicked. The fix widens the bound to `0 ..= self.len()`, aligning with `Vec::insert` semantics.

subject: Ensure correct buffer size during `Octal::fmt`
summary: `Octal::fmt` preallocated a digit buffer of width `usize::BITS / 3` (floor) instead of `ceil(usize::BITS / 3)`, so each storage-element body chunk lost one octal digit. The fix adds `+ (usize::BITS % 3 != 0) as usize`, rounding up.

subject: Fix a bug in `BitSlice::clone_from_bitslice`
summary: When source and destination have different ordering or storage types, clone_from_bitslice incorrectly reads the destination's own bits, leaving it unchanged. The fix reads from src instead. The existing vec::tests::misc test, updated by this commit, appends five Msb0/u16 one-bits to five Lsb0/u8 zero-bits. Reversing the fix leaves all ten destination bits zero, violating its equality assertion. This plan is based on source inspection; no tests were run.
